h1: Custom Flannel Mats for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom flannel mats in bulk for your event or office. Perfect for indoor use with your logo. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Flannel mats offer a soft, absorbent surface that stands up to heavy foot traffic while keeping floors clean and dry. Made from brushed cotton or poly-blend fabric, these mats trap dirt and moisture better than standard entry mats, making them ideal for lobbies, break rooms, or trade show booths. Customize yours with your logo using screen printing or heat transfer for a professional look that lasts through repeated washings.
heroAltText: Custom flannel mats with embroidered logo in office entryway
